title: Honeybee DNA extractions in 96-well plates
author: Tom Harrop
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbayiifw
materials: Set up the reagents from the ZYMO Quick -DNA Magbead Plus Kit
Add the following reagents to the 7-position ReservoirRack

steps.title: Dissect tissue and add beads
steps.instruction: Dissect approximately eight honeybee drone heads for one sample, pool them into a 2 mL safe‑lock tube, add four 3.2 mm stainless‑steel ball bearings and 500 µL PBS.

steps.title: Homogenise tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenise the tissue for 90 seconds at 20 Hz using a Mixer Mill or Tissue Lyser.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate for 10 minutes at 16,000 g, 21 °C, then remove and discard the supernatant (PBS).

steps.title: Transfer tissue paste
steps.instruction: Transfer about 150 mg of the resulting tissue paste to a 96‑well plate for lysis; store any remaining paste at –80 °C for later use.

steps.title: Prepare and add lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 300 µL lysis buffer per well by mixing 287 µL lysis solution, 3 µL RNase solution (10 mg/mL), and 10 µL Proteinase K solution (20 mg/mL). Add the 300 µL buffer to each well of the tissue plate.

steps.title: Spin plate
steps.instruction: Spin the plate for 10 minutes at 1,000 rpm, 15 °C.

steps.title: Seal, mix and incubate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate, resuspend the paste by mixing on a plate shaker, then incubate at 55 °C for 150 minutes while shaking at 1,000 rpm (or shake for 1 minute every 30 minutes).

substeps.instruction: Mix on a plate shaker until the paste is fully resuspended.
Incubate at 55 °C for 150 minutes with shaking at 1,000 rpm (or 1 min every 30 min).

steps.title: Transfer lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the lysate from each well to a new extraction plate.

steps.title: Copy epMotion program
steps.instruction: Copy the master epMotion program located at Dearden/Tom/Quick-DNA Magbead Plus/88x Quick-DNA Magbead Plus premixed beads DNA rinse to your Runs directory and rename the file to include today’s date.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the master program path.
Copy the file to the Runs directory.
Rename the copy with the current date.

steps.title: Edit epMotion steps
steps.instruction: In the copied protocol, change the sample number at steps 1 and 55, and delete rinse steps 42 through 52, keeping only the rinse steps for columns that contain samples.

substeps.instruction: Modify the sample number entries at steps 1 and 55.
Remove rinse steps 42‑52, retaining only those columns with samples.

steps.title: Run epMotion protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the epMotion 88x Quick‑DNA Magbead Plus protocol with level‑sensing enabled.
